One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. Trying costs 210 separate visits, each one billed £55 at the door a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. The tally keeps reef. Every knoll is counted once. The tundra is on the docket.
